claims.claim: Serve's Q2 2026 revenue grew 404% year over year to $3.2M and recurring revenue exceeded 50% of total revenue.
DoorDash revenue grew nearly 50% sequentially and Serve added Grubhub/Wonder in August, increasing platform diversification beyond Uber Eats.

risks.risk: Absolute revenue remains small despite high growth rates.

contradictions.contradiction: Rapid platform expansion contrasts with lower-than-expected Uber Eats delivery volume that caused a full-year guidance cut.

unknowns.unknown: Economics by delivery platform and advertising versus delivery revenue are not fully disclosed.

claims.claim: Serve revised full-year 2026 revenue guidance down to $9M-$10M because Uber Eats delivery volume was below expectations and projected second-half demand was removed.
The company retained $240.4M of cash and marketable securities at June 30, giving it runway to redirect capital toward higher-return fleet opportunities.

risks.risk: A major demand partner underperformed expectations, demonstrating utilization and customer-demand risk despite fleet scale.

contradictions.contradiction: Operational footprint and partner count expanded while 2026 revenue expectations materially declined.

unknowns.unknown: Whether Grubhub, DoorDash, healthcare and advertising growth can offset the removed Uber Eats demand within the next reporting periods is unknown.
